quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his first playoff game win
quotes.excerpt: Up until that point, I never won a playoff game. So, I was hyped.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: There is a clip of you on the bench with LeBron James.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: Up until that point, I never won a playoff game. So, I was hyped. I was like, I am about to win my first playoff game in nine seasons. I did not know how to act. I was just hyped.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the potential of post-game live streams
quotes.excerpt: I thought about that a few times. It would be sick, authentic and raw.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: I saw someone, I do not know if it was Jaylen Brown, say that instead of doing post-game interviews, you should do post-game lives.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I thought about that a few times. It would be sick, authentic and raw. No one, you have all control. No reporters that do all the weird stuff to make you look crazy. You have the control.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the Jared McCain trade
quotes.excerpt: I am very happy for Jared McCain. I wish we kept him, obviously, but I think he went to a good situation.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What are your thoughts on the Jared McCain trade?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I am very happy for Jared McCain. I wish we kept him, obviously, but I think he went to a good situation, a team that is going to help him develop and help him grow. I love the kid to death. Very, very good kid.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the Thunder's performance against the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: The Thunder looked defeated. They were missing shots.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: The Thunder looked like they were just off. And they were missing, they were missing shots.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: They looked defeated. Yeah, they looked defeated. It was a tough game to watch.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: N3on's take on the Spurs' roster completeness
quotes.excerpt: I think that Spurs team is more complete than the prime Golden State Warriors.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Unpopular opinion, I think that Spurs team is more complete than the prime Golden State Warriors.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I do not know. I was around for that. That is a tough one.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his trade experiences
quotes.excerpt: The first time in Detroit when I got traded to Cleveland, I think that was the first time I felt real sadness.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: How does the process go when you are getting traded?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: The first time in Detroit when I got traded to Cleveland, I think that was the first time I felt real sadness. I did not want to leave. I felt like I had so much more to give to Detroit. I wanted to end my career there. The second time was the Philadelphia trade to Brooklyn for James Harden and with Ben Simmons and Seth Curry.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on Joel Embiid's skill level
quotes.excerpt: I played Joel Embiid every game before pre-game. I know that man's game like the back of my hand.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What about Joel Embiid?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I played Joel Embiid every game before pre-game. I know that man's game like the back of my hand. I would not say I would beat him. I just know his game.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the most underrated player
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese Maxey is the dog. So fast, so quick, such a great shooter.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who do you think is the most underrated guy right now in the game, in the NBA?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: Tyrese Maxey. Tyrese Maxey is the dog. So fast, so quick, such a great shooter.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the Celtics' roster and Stephen Adams
quotes.excerpt: If Stephen Adams was playing, I think you guys had a better chance.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: I think that Spurs team is more complete than the prime Golden State Warriors.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: If Stephen Adams was playing, I think you guys had a better chance. You guys were struggling in the paint, though. And then Stephen Adams got injured, and it is just like, fuck, bro. He did not get what he was expecting.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on Michael Jordan as the GOAT
quotes.excerpt: My GOAT is Michael Jordan, by default. My mom is a super Michael Jordan fan.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who is your GOAT?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: My GOAT is Michael Jordan, by default. My mom is a super Michael Jordan fan, so that is who I grew up hearing about all day and all night.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his MVP performance in the Rising Stars game
quotes.excerpt: Winning the MVP of the Rising Star game. I felt like I should have been an All-Star.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What was the best moment of your career?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: Winning the MVP of the Rising Star game. I felt like I should have been an All-Star that game, and the next year I was an All-Star.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his playing style
quotes.excerpt: I am a natural athlete. You can be able to keep up with the game.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who did I resemble when I was playing today?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: You. I am a natural athlete. You can be able to keep up with the game.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his role as a rebounder
quotes.excerpt: Everybody needs a rebounder, so I managed to stick around.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Do you ever like make rookies do something, right? Like pay for the meal, clean your towel?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I do not usually do that to the rookies. I am usually one to take the rookies out to eat. Everybody needs a rebounder, so I managed to stick around and then was able to add a different layer to my game this year.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on the importance of player development
quotes.excerpt: I think where you get drafted is huge in terms of what your player development is.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: If you get drafted in the wrong situation, it could mess up your career.

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I think where you get drafted is huge in terms of what your player development is, what your role is going to be and what they drafted you for.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his career goals
quotes.excerpt: I wanted to end my career there. I wanted to win a championship in Detroit.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What was the goal?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I wanted to end my career there. I wanted to win a championship in Detroit. It was hard. I cried. I sat in my car and cried for hours.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his new hobby, pickleball
quotes.excerpt: Pickleball now is my new thing. I currently have the number one player in pickleball, Gabe Vincent.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Do you watch any other sports?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: Pickleball now is my new thing. I currently have the number one player in pickleball, Gabe Vincent. Shout out to another street sport athlete. Shout out to Eric Porter again.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his role with the Lakers
quotes.excerpt: LeBron James is probably one of the smartest guys I have been in a locker room with.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: How is LeBron James in the locker room?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: LeBron James is probably one of the smartest guys I have been in a locker room with. Very detail-oriented. He knows the other scout, the other team's scout report, top to bottom. Knows everybody's percentage.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: I am here to say that I am one of the most talented people I have ever played with.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: Who do you think is the most underrated guy right now?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: I am here to say that I am one of the most talented people I have ever played with, against and got to work out with.

quotes.speaker: Andre Drummond
quotes.summary_phrase: Andre Drummond on his defensive play
quotes.excerpt: He is really starting to like come into his own. He is adjusting to playing with Jalen Brunson.

text_blocks.speaker: N3on
text_blocks.text: What are your thoughts on Stephen Curry?

text_blocks.speaker: Andre Drummond
text_blocks.text: He is really starting to like come into his own. He is adjusting to playing with Jalen Brunson and the rest of those guys, too. And he knows his role.
